rationale: These values are preregistered engineering acceptance floors, not empirically estimated performance priors. Their purpose is to prevent a system from qualifying on paired improvement while remaining below an engineeringly useful absolute performance level. Statistical/comparative evidence is provided separately by the preregistered paired test against the co-run BM25 baseline.
note: Recorded as a separate artifact rather than an edit to the preregistration, so the preregistration's own hash and its 'written before any scoring' claim remain intact and independently checkable.
